findings.candidAssessment: All 20 items have one defensible key, and all 120 within-item alternative pairs are substantively distinct. The two full-sentence English items (Q07 and Q09) are themselves a strong repetition pair: both ask for the one correct sentence using the same four agreement patterns. Six other English items retain the two-blank/four-combination format. Eight x-domain Condition items and four exact-value fraction items repeat their respective response frames. Some fraction distractors, especially 57 in Q04 and 34/53 in Q05, are distinct but weakly motivated. No item falls outside the stated 2–3 difficulty target.
